_comment: FICTIONAL demo: an invented country and invented instruments, so the agent can run end to end offline.
briefing_topic: The general election in the fictional Republic of Arcadia: control of the Lower House and the Upper House, and two closely watched districts.

binary.question: Will the Green Party win a majority (101 of 200 seats) in the Arcadian Lower House?
binary.yes_means: the Green Party holds at least 101 Lower House seats when the official results are certified
binary.notes: Coalitions do not count: only seats won by the Green Party itself.

binary.question: Will the Green Party control the Arcadian Upper House?
binary.yes_means: the Green Party holds at least 31 of 60 Upper House seats after the election

binary.question: Will the Green Party candidate win District 1?
binary.yes_means: the Green Party candidate is declared the winner of District 1

binary.question: Will the Green Party candidate win District 2?
binary.yes_means: the Green Party candidate is declared the winner of District 2
binary.notes: District 2 uses a ranked-choice count: the question is who wins after all rounds.

move_window: from the close on the election day to the close on the next trading day
move_briefing_topic: Arcadian equities, equity volatility and 10-year government bond yields around the election.
